name: Birdwatcher Joan

intro.text: Pied flycatchers nest in the oak woods in the gorge. Look, that's one! No, that's a leaf. Look, that's a leaf!

win: Oh, I missed a flycatcher for that.
after: A pied flycatcher can find its way from West Africa back to the same oak. I find my way back to the car park with a map.
